section_1_cloze.passage:
I received a private message on a social media platform. It began harmlessly enough: "Hey, girl. Wanted to invite you to join my next challenge group — we'll be focusing on fitting in 30 minutes of [41] and balanced nutrition."

It was all becoming too much. The social media platform was running my life, not me. But what killed it for me was when I [42] a photo, and five minutes later my son asked me how many "likes" it had got. His question was a wake-up call.

"Likes" are signs of acceptance and approval. I had forgotten that acceptance and approval need to come from within and had [43] set him a bad example.

Before the social media platform, surfing the Internet was a(n) [44] distraction and I spent a lot more time reading books and magazines. I checked in with friends through [45], emails and phone calls.

To [46] the simplicity(质朴) of those days and set a better example for my son, I deactivated my account of the platform. I'd been in the [47] of checking it many times a day, so I had to [48] something new. I [49] a crossword puzzle book around with me. I rediscovered knitting(针织). My body is fine just the way it is. I have friends who will help me out when I'm in trouble. I do my best to be a good mother, and our son is happy and healthy. We are lucky to be able to afford two [50] to spend together a year.

It is not an [55] any more.

questions.explanation: 根据后文的“balanced nutrition(均衡营养)”可知，挑战小组的重点是“锻炼(exercise)”与“营养”的结合，这是常见的健康生活搭配。sleep（睡眠）、breath（呼吸）、break（休息）均不如 exercise 符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(exercise)：语境句：Regular exercise is beneficial to your physical and mental health. 固定搭配：take exercise, physical exercise
B(sleep)：语境句：A good night's sleep is essential for proper brain function. 固定搭配：go to sleep, fall asleep
C(breath)：语境句：He took a deep breath and dived into the swimming pool. 固定搭配：catch one's breath, out of breath
D(break)：语境句：Let's take a short break to grab a cup of coffee. 固定搭配：take a break, coffee break

questions.explanation: 在社交媒体平台上发布照片，最恰当的动词是 post（发布，发帖子）。hung（悬挂）、took（拍摄，指拍照动作本身而不指发布）、drew（画）均不符合社交媒体分享的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(hung)：语境句：She hung the painting on the wall to decorate her new room. 固定搭配：hang up, hang out
B(posted)：语境句：He posted his travel photos on social media to share with friends. 固定搭配：post online, keep someone posted
C(took)：语境句：He took some amazing pictures during his trip to Tibet. 固定搭配：take photos, take time
D(drew)：语境句：She drew a beautiful portrait of her mother for her birthday. 固定搭配：draw a conclusion, draw attention

questions.explanation: 前文提到“我忘记了接受和认可需要源于内心”，说明作者是在没意识到的情况下给儿子树立了坏榜样，故选 unknowingly（不知不觉地）。unwillingly（不情愿地）、untiringly（不倦地）、unfailingly（无一例外地）均不符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(unwillingly)：语境句：He unwillingly admitted his mistake after being questioned. 固定搭配：unwillingly accept, do sth unwillingly
B(untiringly)：语境句：The volunteers worked untiringly to help the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：work untiringly, strive untiringly
C(unknowingly)：语境句：She had unknowingly exposed her personal information to hackers. 固定搭配：unknowingly cause, do sth unknowingly
D(unfailingly)：语境句：He is unfailingly polite to everyone he meets. 固定搭配：unfailingly polite, unfailingly supportive

questions.explanation: 对比现在社交媒体“统治”生活，以前上网只是“偶尔的(occasional)”消遣，大部分时间用来读书看报。abrupt（突然的）、constant（持续不断的，与过去情况相反）、usual（寻常的）均不贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(abrupt)：语境句：His abrupt departure from the meeting surprised everyone. 固定搭配：an abrupt end, an abrupt change
B(occasional)：语境句：She likes playing tennis, but only on an occasional basis. 固定搭配：occasional rain, on an occasional basis
C(constant)：语境句：The patient requires constant care and observation. 固定搭配：constant complaints, constant change
D(usual)：语境句：As usual, he was the last one to arrive at the office. 固定搭配：as usual, the usual way

questions.explanation: 与电子邮件(emails)和打电话(phone calls)并列的日常联络方式应为 texts（短信）。films（电影）、novels（小说）、diaries（日记）不是通讯方式。
questions.supplement:
A(films)：语境句：Watching foreign films is a great way to improve language skills. 固定搭配：shoot a film, direct a film
B(novels)：语境句：She enjoys reading science fiction novels in her spare time. 固定搭配：read novels, write a novel
C(diaries)：语境句：Keeping diaries helps her reflect on her daily experiences. 固定搭配：keep a diary, write in a diary
D(texts)：语境句：They prefer communicating through texts rather than phone calls. 固定搭配：send texts, text messages

questions.explanation: 作者注销账号是为了“再现/重塑(recreate)”过去的质朴生活。replace（替换）、recall（回忆，停留在脑海中）、review（复习/回顾）不如 recreate 体现作者采取实际行动去恢复过去的生活状态。
questions.supplement:
A(replace)：语境句：We need to replace the old equipment with more advanced ones. 固定搭配：replace A with B, replace sb as...
B(recall)：语境句：I can hardly recall the exact details of that event. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, beyond recall
C(recreate)：语境句：The museum aims to recreate the historical scene for its visitors. 固定搭配：recreate the atmosphere, recreate the scene
D(review)：语境句：It's highly recommended to review your notes before the exam. 固定搭配：review the lessons, a book review

questions.explanation: be in the habit of doing sth 是固定搭配，表示“有做某事的习惯”。作者过去有每天多次查看社交媒体的习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(custom)：语境句：It is a local custom to exchange gifts during the festival. 固定搭配：local custom, social custom
B(habit)：语境句：Getting up early is a good habit that benefits your health. 固定搭配：be in the habit of, form a habit
C(skill)：语境句：Learning a new language requires patience and communication skill. 固定搭配：improve a skill, practical skill
D(ability)：语境句：She has the ability to solve complex mathematical problems. 固定搭配：have the ability to do, reading ability

questions.explanation: 作者停用了社交媒体，有了空闲时间，所以必须“想出/找到(come up with)”新事物来做。get rid of（摆脱）、keep away from（远离）、break away from（脱离）均不符合寻找新爱好的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(get rid of)：语境句：He is trying to get rid of his old car and buy a new one. 固定搭配：get rid of bad habits, get rid of poverty
B(keep away from)：语境句：Parents should keep children away from dangerous chemicals. 固定搭配：keep away from danger, keep away from fire
C(come up with)：语境句：Our team came up with a brilliant idea for the marketing campaign. 固定搭配：come up with a solution, come up with an idea
D(break away from)：语境句：It is difficult for him to break away from traditional ideas. 固定搭配：break away from tradition, break away from the past

questions.explanation: 为了不看手机，作者随身“携带(carried)”一本填字游戏书。carry around 是固定搭配，意为“随身携带”。
questions.supplement:
A(carried)：语境句：She carried a small notebook around to write down ideas. 固定搭配：carry around, carry out
B(bought)：语境句：I bought some fresh vegetables from the supermarket. 固定搭配：buy sth for sb, buy off
C(borrowed)：语境句：He borrowed a dictionary from the library to help with his translation. 固定搭配：borrow sth from sb, borrow money
D(wrote)：语境句：She wrote a letter of apology to explain her absence. 固定搭配：write down, write to sb

questions.explanation: 语境表达作者一家生活得很幸福，很幸运一年能负担得起两次共同度过的“假期(vacations)”。tickets（票）、weekends（周末，一年有52个，不符常理）、treats（款待）均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(tickets)：语境句：I have booked two tickets for the concert this Saturday. 固定搭配：book tickets, flight tickets
B(weekends)：语境句：We usually spend our weekends hanging out with friends. 固定搭配：on weekends, at the weekend
C(treats)：语境句：My uncle bought us ice cream as a special treat. 固定搭配：a special treat, treat sb to sth
D(vacations)：语境句：We are planning to take two vacations to Europe next year. 固定搭配：on vacation, summer vacation

questions.explanation: 作者找到了新爱好，回到了现实生活，因此“停止(stopped)”了透过手机看世界。enjoyed（享受）、imagined（想象）、admitted（承认）均与作者摆脱手机依赖的语境相反。
questions.supplement:
A(stopped)：语境句：He stopped smoking entirely for the sake of his health. 固定搭配：stop doing sth, stop sb from doing
B(enjoyed)：语境句：We greatly enjoyed our stay at the beautiful resort. 固定搭配：enjoy doing sth, enjoy oneself
C(imagined)：语境句：I never imagined that I would meet my primary school friend here. 固定搭配：imagine doing sth, hard to imagine
D(admitted)：语境句：He reluctantly admitted having made a serious mistake. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to sth

questions.explanation: 几周后作者重返社交媒体，查看朋友孩子们长大的“照片(photos)”，与前文的 posted a photo 呼应。news（新闻）、notices（通知）、reports（报告）不符合看孩子成长动态的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(news)：语境句：Have you heard the good news about his promotion? 固定搭配：break the news, latest news
B(notices)：语境句：There are some important notices pinned on the bulletin board. 固定搭配：put up a notice, until further notice
C(reports)：语境句：According to the latest reports, the economy is recovering slowly. 固定搭配：weather report, write a report
D(photos)：语境句：She showed me some beautiful photos of her graduation ceremony. 固定搭配：take photos, share photos

questions.explanation: 经过休息调整后，作者现在能够“感激/欣赏(appreciate)”社交媒体带来的好处（如与远方家人保持联系）。forgive（原谅）、question（质疑）、wonder（想知道）均不合题意。
questions.supplement:
A(appreciate)：语境句：I really appreciate your timely help during the crisis. 固定搭配：appreciate doing sth, highly appreciate
B(forgive)：语境句：I hope you can forgive me for my careless mistake. 固定搭配：forgive sb for doing, forgive and forget
C(question)：语境句：Nobody dared to question his authority in the company. 固定搭配：out of the question, without question
D(wonder)：语境句：I wonder if you could do me a favor and give me a ride. 固定搭配：no wonder, wonder about

questions.explanation: 作者现在每天也会看社交媒体，但不再有频繁更新的“欲望(desire)”了。promise（承诺）、advice（建议）、mood（情绪）不符合此处表达的内心冲动。
questions.supplement:
A(promise)：语境句：He made a promise that he would never lie to me again. 固定搭配：make a promise, keep a promise
B(desire)：语境句：She has a strong desire to travel around the world. 固定搭配：have a desire to do, a burning desire
C(advice)：语境句：My teacher gave me some valuable advice on how to improve my writing. 固定搭配：give advice, take one's advice
D(mood)：语境句：Listening to light music always puts me in a good mood. 固定搭配：in a good mood, in no mood for

questions.explanation: 文章主旨是作者摆脱了对社交媒体的沉迷。最后总结说，社交媒体对她而言不再是一种“上瘾(addiction)”。excuse（借口）、advantage（优势）、experience（经历）不能总结作者的心路历程。
questions.supplement:
A(excuse)：语境句：There is no excuse for your arriving late for the interview. 固定搭配：make an excuse, find an excuse
B(advantage)：语境句：Living in a big city has the advantage of convenient transportation. 固定搭配：take advantage of, have an advantage over
C(experience)：语境句：She has a lot of experience in dealing with customer complaints. 固定搭配：gain experience, rich in experience
D(addiction)：语境句：His addiction to computer games has severely affected his academic performance. 固定搭配：Internet addiction, overcome an addiction

vocab_pack.definition_en: a message sent directly to a specific user on a social media platform
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在句中作宾语，前有不定冠词a，单数形式
vocab_pack.example_en: I received a private message from an old friend on WeChat.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我在微信上收到了一位老朋友发来的私信。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I received a private message on a social media platform.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a website or application that allows users to create and share content or participate in social networking
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词on的宾语，单数形式，前有不定冠词a
vocab_pack.example_en: Instagram is a popular social media platform for sharing photos.
vocab_pack.example_zh: Instagram是一个流行的分享照片的社交媒体平台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I received a private message on a social media platform.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a lot of attention to a particular subject or activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文用现在分词形式focusing on，构成将来进行时（will be focusing on），表示将专注于某事
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to focus on improving our communication skills.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要专注于提高沟通技巧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we'll be focusing on fitting in 30 minutes of exercise and balanced nutrition.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find time to do something as part of a schedule; to be compatible or accepted within a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文用动名词形式fitting in，作介词on的宾语，表示把某事安排进日程
vocab_pack.example_en: I try to fit in a 30-minute workout every morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我每天早上尽量安排30分钟锻炼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we'll be focusing on fitting in 30 minutes of exercise and balanced nutrition.

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event that makes people realize they need to change their behavior or take action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作句子的表语（His question was a wake-up call），意为一个提醒或警示
vocab_pack.example_en: The accident was a wake-up call for the company to improve safety.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那起事故给公司敲响了警钟，要求提高安全性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His question was a wake-up call.

vocab_pack.definition_en: indication or evidence of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，原文为复数形式signs of，在句中作表语，后接acceptance and approval，表示“……的标志”
vocab_pack.example_en: Dark clouds are often a sign of rain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 乌云通常是下雨的迹象。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Likes" are signs of acceptance and approval.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of agreeing that something is true or satisfactory; approval
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，与approval并列，作介词of的宾语，表示“接受”
vocab_pack.example_en: He finally gained his father's acceptance of his career choice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他最终获得了父亲对他职业选择的认可。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Likes" are signs of acceptance and approval.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the belief that something is good or acceptable; official agreement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，与acceptance并列，作介词of的宾语，表示“认可”
vocab_pack.example_en: The project still needs the manager's approval.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目仍需经理的批准。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Likes" are signs of acceptance and approval.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to originate from one's inner self, not from external sources
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为不定式to come from within，作need的宾语，表示“来自内心”
vocab_pack.example_en: True confidence must come from within, not from others' praise.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 真正的自信必须来自内心，而不是来自别人的赞美。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had forgotten that acceptance and approval need to come from within.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to behave in a way that others, especially children, are likely to imitate and that is considered negative
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为过去式set（与动词原形同形），后接间接宾语him和直接宾语a bad example，表示“给他树立了坏榜样”
vocab_pack.example_en: Parents who use bad language set a bad example for their children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 说脏话的父母给孩子树立了坏榜样。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I ... had unknowingly set him a bad example.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look at various websites or pages on the Internet for information or entertainment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文用动名词形式surfing the Internet，作主语（Surfing the Internet was a distraction），表示“上网”这一活动
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people spend hours surfing the Internet every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人每天花几个小时上网。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Before the social media platform, surfing the Internet was a(n) occasional distraction.

vocab_pack.definition_en: happening sometimes but not often or regularly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰名词distraction，在句中作定语，表示“偶尔的”
vocab_pack.example_en: I enjoy an occasional cup of coffee in the afternoon.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我偶尔下午享受一杯咖啡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Before the social media platform, surfing the Internet was a(n) occasional distraction.

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that prevents you from giving your full attention to something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作表语，被形容词occasional修饰，表示“分心的事”
vocab_pack.example_en: The noise outside was a constant distraction while I was studying.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 外面的噪音在我学习时持续干扰着我。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Before the social media platform, surfing the Internet was a(n) occasional distraction.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to contact someone to find out how they are or to give a progress report
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 与……联系（了解情况或汇报进展）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为过去式checked in with，后接friends，表示“与朋友联系（以了解近况）”
vocab_pack.example_en: I always check in with my parents when I travel abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我出国旅行时总是跟父母保持联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I checked in with friends through texts, emails and phone calls.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something (e.g., an account) inactive or no longer usable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词，原文为过去式deactivated，后接my account，表示“注销了我的账号”
vocab_pack.example_en: I decided to deactivate my social media account for a while.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我决定暂时停用我的社交媒体账号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I deactivated my account of the platform.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have the regular behavior of doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，原文为过去完成时had been in the habit of，表示“曾经习惯做某事”，been是be的过去分词
vocab_pack.example_en: She is in the habit of jogging every morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她习惯每天早上慢跑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I'd been in the habit of checking it many times a day.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think of or produce an idea, plan, solution, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为不定式come up with，与had to连用表示“不得不想出”，后接something new作宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to come up with a creative solution to this problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要想出一个有创意的解决方案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had to come up with something new.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a puzzle in which words are written into a grid of squares, using clues
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作定语修饰book，表示“填字游戏书”
vocab_pack.example_en: I like doing crossword puzzles to pass the time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢做填字游戏来打发时间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I carried a crossword puzzle book around with me.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find or learn about something again that was forgotten or neglected
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词，原文为过去式rediscovered，后接knitting，表示“重新发现了针织的乐趣”
vocab_pack.example_en: After years of not painting, she rediscovered her passion for art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多年不画画后，她重新发现了对艺术的热情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I rediscovered knitting.

vocab_pack.definition_en: exactly as it is, without any change or improvement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，作方式状语，修饰is fine，表示“身体保持原样就很好”
vocab_pack.example_en: Sometimes you have to accept things just the way they are.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有时候你不得不接受事情本来的样子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My body is fine just the way it is.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assist someone, especially when they are in a difficult situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为将来时will help me out，后接直接宾语me，表示“会帮我摆脱困境”
vocab_pack.example_en: My friends always help me out when I'm in trouble.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我遇到困难时朋友们总是帮我。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have friends who will help me out when I'm in trouble.

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a situation involving difficulty, danger, or punishment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，作表语（when I'm in trouble），表示“处于困境”
vocab_pack.example_en: If you don't finish your homework on time, you will be in trouble.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你不按时完成作业，你就会有麻烦。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have friends who will help me out when I'm in trouble.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try as hard as possible to achieve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，原文为一般现在时do my best，主语为I，表示“我尽力”
vocab_pack.example_en: I will do my best to finish the project on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我会尽最大努力按时完成这个项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I do my best to be a good mother.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be fully aware and engaged in what is happening now, not distracted by past or future
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语，原文中felt是系动词，present in the moment作表语，表示“感到活在当下”
vocab_pack.example_en: Yoga helps me be present in the moment and reduce stress.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 瑜伽帮助我活在当下，减轻压力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I felt frequently present in the moment.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to have a particular feeling or state as a result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 搭配结构，原文为过去式left me feeling better，left是leave的过去式，表示“让我感觉更好”
vocab_pack.example_en: The relaxing music left me feeling calm and peaceful.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 放松的音乐让我感到平静安宁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The break left me feeling better about myself, my family, my home and my life.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to quickly read or examine something, especially a document or website
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文为一般现在时look through，后接it（指代社交媒体平台），表示“浏览它”
vocab_pack.example_en: I usually look through the news before breakfast.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我通常早餐前浏览一下新闻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I look through it on a daily basis.

vocab_pack.definition_en: every day; as a regular daily practice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，作时间状语，修饰look through，表示“每天”
vocab_pack.example_en: We should exercise on a daily basis to stay healthy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该每天锻炼以保持健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I look through it on a daily basis.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong feeling of wanting to have something or to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，原文为with the desire to update it，作介词with的宾语，表示“带有……的渴望”
vocab_pack.example_en: She has a strong desire to travel around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她强烈渴望环游世界。
vocab_pack.from_passage: no longer with the desire frequently to update it.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to add the most recent information or make something more current
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词，原文为不定式to update，作后置定语修饰desire，表示“更新的渴望”
vocab_pack.example_en: I need to update my resume before applying for the job.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在申请工作前，我需要更新我的简历。
vocab_pack.from_passage: no longer with the desire frequently to update it.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the condition of being unable to stop doing or using something, especially something harmful
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作表语（It is not an addiction any more），表示“不再是上瘾”
vocab_pack.example_en: He struggled with a drug addiction for many years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他多年来与毒瘾作斗争。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It is not an addiction any more.

section_2_word_form.passage:
Despite being a lesser-known Chinese sport, the game of jianzi is definitely familiar to people in Asia. Who hasn't seen a group of elderly men kicking around [56] colourful, feathered shuttlecock(毽子) in the park?

Dating all the way back [57] the ancient Zhou Dynasty of China, the sport of jianzi was mainly played among Chinese youth as a [58] way to exercise. It is believed that the fundamental gameplay and style came from a football-like game [59] cuju. Due to the game's simplicity and ease of play, many children created makeshift shuttlecocks at home, [60] round pieces of lead or tin with chicken feathers. During the war-torn Dynasties of Han and Song from 207 to 906 AD, the [61] of jianzi exploded. Leaders used the game [62] their troops alongside military exercises.

In 1933, China hosted the first national jianzi competition after the sport's massive rise. A 1961 movie [63] talked about the game won a gold medal at an international film festival, further spreading the word about the sport. In 1984, jianzi [64] officially as a Chinese national sport, and that same year saw the creation of the Hong Kong-based team, Amateur Union of Shuttlecock. By 1994, the Hong Kong team [65] grew into a reformed union known as the Hong Kong Association of Shuttlecock(HKSA).

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一个”色彩缤纷、带羽毛的毽子。shuttlecock 为可数名词单数，且 colourful 发音以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：I need to buy a new laptop for my upcoming college studies. 固定搭配：a piece of, a pair of。其它变形/搭配：an (用于元音发音前), the (定冠词表示特指)。

questions.explanation: date back to 是固定搭配，意为“追溯到”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The custom of eating turkey on Thanksgiving dates back to the 17th century. 固定搭配：date back to, lead to。其它变形/搭配：None。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 way，需要用形容词形式。create 的形容词是 creative，意为“有创造力的，创造性的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(creative)：语境句：She always comes up with creative ideas for our team projects. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative。原词create其它变形：creation(n.), creator(n.), creatively(adv.)。

questions.explanation: game 与 name 之间是动宾关系（被命名为），因此使用过去分词 named 作后置定语修饰 game。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：I adopted a stray dog and named him Max. 固定搭配：be named after, namely。原词name其它变形：namely(adv.), nameless(adj.)。

questions.explanation: children 与 use 之间是主动关系，此处用现在分词 using 作伴随状语，表示“用……（制作）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(using)：语境句：They managed to solve the problem using a completely new approach. 固定搭配：use up, make use of。原词use其它变形：useful(adj.), useless(adj.), usage(n.)。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 the 之后应接名词作主语，popular 的名词形式是 popularity，意为“受欢迎，普及”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(popularity)：语境句：The new smartphone has gained immense popularity among young people. 固定搭配：gain popularity, grow in popularity。原词popular其它变形：popularize(v.), popularly(adv.)。

questions.explanation: use sth to do sth 是固定句型，表示“使用某物去做某事”，此处用动词不定式作目的状语。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to train)：语境句：The company hired a professional coach to train the new employees. 固定搭配：train sb to do sth, training program。原词train其它变形：training(n.), trainer(n.), trainee(n.)。

questions.explanation: 此处为限制性定语从句，先行词是 A 1961 movie（物），且在从句中作主语，所以填关系代词 that 或 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：The book that I bought yesterday is extremely fascinating. 固定搭配：in that, which is to say。其它变形/搭配：who, whom, whose。

questions.explanation: 主语 jianzi 与 recognize 为被动关系，且根据时间状语 In 1984 可知，时态为一般过去时，故填 was recognized。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was recognized)：语境句：His outstanding contribution to the field of science was universally recognized. 固定搭配：recognize A as B, be recognized as。原词recognize其它变形：recognition(n.), recognizable(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词 grew，需要使用副词。steady 的副词形式为 steadily，意为“稳定地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(steadily)：语境句：The company's profits have been steadily increasing over the past five years. 固定搭配：grow steadily, increase steadily。原词steady其它变形：steady(adj. 作为形容词), steadiness(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: not widely known or famous
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，修饰 sports（运动），作定语，表示鲜为人知的。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is a lesser-known author, but his works are brilliant.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是一位鲜为人知的作家，但他的作品非常出色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Despite being a lesser-known Chinese sport

vocab_pack.definition_en: known or recognized by someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: be familiar to 结构，文中 is definitely familiar to，一般现在时，主语 the game。注意与 familiar with 的区别。
vocab_pack.example_en: This song is familiar to most young people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首歌大多数年轻人都很熟悉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is definitely familiar to people in Asia

vocab_pack.definition_en: old; aged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 men（男性），表示年长的男性。
vocab_pack.example_en: The elderly woman walked slowly across the street.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位年长的妇女慢慢地穿过街道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a group of elderly men

vocab_pack.definition_en: to kick something casually or aimlessly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示正在进行的动作。kicking 为动词的现在分词形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children kicked around a ball in the yard.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们在院子里随便踢球。
vocab_pack.from_passage: kicking around a colourful, feathered shuttlecock

vocab_pack.definition_en: a small object with feathers, used in games like badminton or jianzi
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作宾语，文中指毽子。
vocab_pack.example_en: The shuttlecock flew high into the air.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毽子高高飞向空中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a colourful, feathered shuttlecock

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: Dating all the way back to
vocab_pack.definition_en: to originate from a particular time in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，表示时间上的追溯。dating 为动词的现在分词形式，all the way 强调时间久远。
vocab_pack.example_en: This tradition dates back to the 15th century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这一传统可追溯到 15 世纪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Dating all the way back to the ancient Zhou Dynasty of China

vocab_pack.definition_en: the way a game is played, its rules and design
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，与 style 并列作主语，指运动的基本玩法和风格。
vocab_pack.example_en: The gameplay of this video game is very addictive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款视频游戏的玩法非常令人上瘾。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the fundamental gameplay and style

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have originated from
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，came 为 come 的过去式，表示过去的事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: The idea came from a conversation I had with my teacher.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个想法来自我和老师的一次谈话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: came from a football-like game named cuju

vocab_pack.definition_en: made as a temporary substitute, improvised
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 shuttlecocks（毽子），表示自制的、临时做成的。
vocab_pack.example_en: They built a makeshift shelter from branches.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们用树枝搭了一个临时避难所。
vocab_pack.from_passage: many children created makeshift shuttlecocks

vocab_pack.definition_en: severely damaged by war
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 饱受战争蹂躏的，战乱的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，修饰 Dynasties（朝代），表示战乱的朝代。
vocab_pack.example_en: The war-torn country is struggling to rebuild.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个饱受战争摧残的国家正努力重建。
vocab_pack.from_passage: During the war-torn Dynasties of Han and Song

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase suddenly and rapidly (figurative)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，exploded 为过去式，此处比喻用法，表示流行程度突然大增。
vocab_pack.example_en: The population of the city exploded in the 20th century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市的人口在 20 世纪急剧增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the popularity of jianzi exploded

vocab_pack.definition_en: soldiers; military forces
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数名词，作 train 的宾语，表示训练军队。
vocab_pack.example_en: The general ordered the troops to advance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 将军命令部队前进。
vocab_pack.from_passage: train their troops

vocab_pack.definition_en: together with; at the side of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词，连接 military exercises，表示连同军事演习一起使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: She worked alongside her colleagues on the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她与同事们一起做这个项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: alongside military exercises

vocab_pack.definition_en: to organize and hold an event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，hosted 为过去式，表示中国主办了第一届全国比赛。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city will host the next Olympic Games.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该城市将举办下一届奥运会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: China hosted the first national jianzi competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: very large in size, amount, or degree
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 rise（兴起），表示巨大的增长。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a massive increase in sales last quarter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 上个季度销售额大幅增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: after the sport's massive rise

vocab_pack.definition_en: to discuss something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 定语从句中一般过去时，talked 为过去式，后接宾语 the game。
vocab_pack.example_en: They talked about their plans for the weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们谈论了周末的计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that/which talked about the game

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be victorious in a competition or achieve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，won 为 win 的过去式，表示电影获得了金牌。
vocab_pack.example_en: She won first prize in the contest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在比赛中赢得了一等奖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: won a gold medal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to tell people about something; to publicize
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作结果状语，spreading 为 spread 的现在分词，further 表示进一步。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please spread the word about the meeting tomorrow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请传达明天会议的消息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: further spreading the word about the sport

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept or acknowledge as being something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，was recognized，as 引出补足语。officially 为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was recognized as a leading expert in the field.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他被公认为该领域的顶尖专家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: jianzi was recognized officially as a Chinese national sport

vocab_pack.definition_en: having its base or headquarters in Hong Kong
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 总部设在香港的，以香港为基地的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，修饰 team（队伍），表示基地在香港。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Hong Kong-based company expanded into mainland China.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家总部在香港的公司扩展到了中国大陆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Hong Kong-based team

vocab_pack.definition_en: to develop gradually into something larger or more advanced
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，grew 为 grow 的过去式，into 表示转变的结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The small startup grew into a multinational corporation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家小初创公司发展成了一家跨国公司。
vocab_pack.from_passage: steadily grew into a reformed union

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make changes to improve a system, organization, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在文中为过去分词 reformed 作形容词，修饰 union，表示经过改革的联合会。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government plans to reform the education system.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府计划改革教育体系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a reformed union

vocab_pack.definition_en: called; named; referred to as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作补语，表示被动含义，意为被称为。
vocab_pack.example_en: This phenomenon is known as global warming.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种现象被称为全球变暖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: known as the Hong Kong Association of Shuttlecock

vocab_pack.definition_en: non-professional; done for love rather than money
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在专有名词中大写首字母，修饰 Union（联合会），表示业余联合会。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is an amateur photographer, but her work is impressive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是一名业余摄影师，但作品令人印象深刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Amateur Union of Shuttlecock

vocab_pack.definition_en: covered with feathers
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 shuttlecock，表示羽毛制成的毽子。
vocab_pack.example_en: The arrow had a feathered tail.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这支箭有一个羽毛做的箭尾。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a colourful, feathered shuttlecock

vocab_pack.definition_en: because of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，后接名词性成分，表示原因。注意大写首字母。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 航班因恶劣天气取消。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Due to the game's simplicity and ease of play

vocab_pack.definition_en: resembling or similar to football
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，修饰 game，表示类似足球的运动。
vocab_pack.example_en: They invented a football-like game with different rules.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们发明了一种规则不同的类似足球的游戏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a football-like game named cuju

vocab_pack.definition_en: involving imagination or original ideas
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 way（方式），表示创造性的锻炼方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: She found a creative solution to the problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她找到了一个创造性的解决方案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as a creative way to exercise

vocab_pack.definition_en: the state of being liked, admired, or enjoyed by many
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作主语，与 exploded 搭配，表示流行程度激增。
vocab_pack.example_en: The popularity of online shopping continues to grow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 网购的受欢迎程度持续增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the popularity of jianzi exploded

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a gradual, regular, and continuous manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰 grew（发展），表示稳步地发展。
vocab_pack.example_en: The economy has been growing steadily over the past decade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 过去十年经济一直在稳步增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: steadily grew into a reformed union
